name: The Seagrass Meadows
riddle: Count the stars that live below, their number opens the door of stone.

steps.objective: Set the stone dial to the number of stars.
Take what lies behind the door.

hints: Stars below the waves don't shine in the sky. Look on the sand, in the seagrass and on the rocks. Touch one and it glows, so you know it's counted.
A door of stone is set into the reef somewhere to the north. Look at what's carved beside it.
Have you counted them all? One star lives where the current won't let you swim up. A friend of the Fish Whisperer might carry you there.

reward.nextRiddle: When noon's light swims through the door, blue shows the way the old ones swore.
reward.message: Map piece III! The way to the Blue Grotto is open.
